title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Oh where do I get my luggage?
The parks and rec building. Are you still on campus?
I can stop there in a bit or do I need a Tigers person with me

No...you'll have to come in the back door which is open to the public. The building is doubling as the box office right now so if you don't know where you're going just ask a security person where the box office is and they'll direct you
Is that where our work room is?
Yes, once everything gets situated that's where it's going to be. It's not available right now
Lynn just went in on his own. I would have told him the same thing I told you if he asked about going in the stadium
